summary: Moves the hosted app to https://brocad-m.visionforge.cc/ after the repository rename. Application assets, deep links, documentation and authoring tools use the custom domain root; source links use the renamed brocad-m repository.
warning: No breaking change to installed posts, project file formats, saved revisions or controller output. The app now uses a new browser origin, which starts with its own browser cache and permissions. No legacy URL routing or automatic storage migration is added.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, CAD, machine package, saved revision or storage schema change.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation, input-version or WebMCP operation change.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No audit, output, numbering, encoding, wrapper or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: Browser cache and folder adapters are unchanged. Project files remain readable. The new domain has separate browser storage and permissions, with no migration or data rewrite.
checklist.verification: Production build and published-link checks; navigation browser journeys for saved-project history, reload and static-host fallback; source distribution test; lint and release checks.

changes: Loads application assets and project routes at the custom domain root.
Updates help, documentation and package authoring links to brocad-m.visionforge.cc, and source links to the renamed repository.
publicNotes.compatibility: Project files, installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged. The new domain has its own browser storage.
publicNotes.action: Open https://brocad-m.visionforge.cc/. Existing exported projects and folder workbenches remain supported.
